hypotheses: Increasing arm and jaw scale multipliers from 0.666 to 0.75 will maintain a high success rate (≥75%) while reducing mean completion time compared to the 0.666 setting.
The unsafe rate will remain zero for the 0.75 scaling.
Success count will be at least 6 out of 8 episodes.
proposal.reason: Observations show that scaling both arm and jaw to 0.666 yields perfect safety and success but slower execution (~7.8s). The baseline (presumed scale 1.0) had lower success and an unsafe event. An intermediate scale of 0.75 may improve speed while preserving safety and success, making it a logical next bounded experiment.
